results.description: sim.js loads in Node and exports createSim, step, PARAMS
Builder's PARAMS equal the Designer's spec params (Designer output reached the Builder)
createSim returns the contract state shape, JSON-serialisable, for all three levels
Default start is the attract screen; a confirm press begins play
Distance covered in 1 s is equal in all eight directions (within 1%) and goes the way the input points
Walking covers the same distance at 60 and 120 steps per second (within 2%)
After the ramp, speed equals spec runSpeed straight and diagonal (within 3%)
Lunge distance is equal in all eight directions (within 1%), equals spec lungeDistance (within 2%), and follows the facing direction when no direction is held
A lunge covers the same distance at 120 steps per second (within 2%)
The lunge is tweened: more than 60% of the distance is covered in the first half of its duration
Direction input during a lunge does not change its path
Holding the lunge button and a direction for 3 s starts exactly one lunge
After a lunge the dummy is 'recovering' for spec recoveryTime, can move during it, and starts slowly
results.detail: recovery 0.35 s, moved 19.6 px during it

results.description: Same seed and inputs give an identical state after 40 s; a different seed gives different traffic
Level 1: every car travels left to right inside the road band, at its class speed, and never stalls (dummy out of the way)
An undisturbed car's reported speed equals its class speed and its real displacement per second, at 60 and 120 steps per second
Level 2: traffic uses both one-way roads (left to right, top to bottom), cars never overlap inside the canvas, and traffic keeps flowing for 150 s (no deadlock)
results.detail: 39 cars through, 18 horizontal, 24 vertical, no overlap

results.description: Level 3: vehicles enter from at least three of the four edges, several classes appear, and cars never overlap inside the canvas
A dummy standing in a lane is seen, the car commits to a side (lock) and the lock does not change afterwards
Front contact reduces health and adds score, once per car
Rear contact changes neither health nor score
At zero health: one write-off counted, a card appears, confirm gives a fresh body
Quota met and allocation spent: level 1 -> 2 -> 3 via a card and confirm
Allocation spent with the quota missed ends the run as 'decommissioned'
The write-off that reaches certificationTarget ends the run as 'licensed' at once
With a dummy standing on the road (at each road edge, so cars must swerve), every level still runs to its end, cars never overlap, never cross a barrier, and the dummy is never left inside a car
With the dummy wandering across the roads and lunging for 90 s per level: cars never overlap each other, never cross a road barrier, and the dummy is never left inside a car
results.detail: L1/s5: 72 lunges, 1 bodies; L1/s9: 72 lunges, 3 bodies; L2/s5: 72 lunges, 4 bodies; L2/s9: 72 lunges, 0 bodies; L3/s5: 72 lunges, 0 bodies; L3/s9: 72 lunges, 1 bodies

results.description: Cars are solid on every side: a dummy placed against a car's side, or walking into it, is pushed out and never ends up inside
Damage from a front impact equals perMomentum x closing speed x class mass (within 15%), for a sedan and a van; the bus is the heaviest class
sim.js uses no Math.random, timers, clock or DOM
index.html has a canvas, loads sim.js, handles the keyboard, uses a fixed timestep and makes no network requests
results.detail: 1 inline script(s) parse without syntax errors
